mina: Heads-up — onboarding support ticket. New user trying the JS starter on Vercel sees build-time failure after our export-map change.

mina: User steps: clone examples/next-starter && npm ci && npm run build -> deploy to Vercel -> build fails. Locally `npm run dev` works but prod fails.

chris: Do you have the error log?

mina: Vercel logs: 
`Error: Package subpath './client' is not defined by "exports" in /node_modules/@redwood/sdk/package.json`
and local Node error when running SSR on Node 16: `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM` pointing at /node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/client.mjs

devon: Likely caused by removing the conditional import/require mapping for the ./client subpath. Some bundlers (Vercel/Next) follow the exports map strictly and won't fall back to top-level main/module. Others (local dev) may resolve differently which explains discrepancy.

olga: Also saw TS auto-imports in the starter pointing at `@redwood/sdk/client` but editors couldn't find types under that subpath — that causes confusing intellisense and wrong imports in generated code.

chris: Quick fix: restore conditional exports for the subpath and expose types. Example we should publish: 
```json
"exports": {
  "./client": {
    "import": "./dist/client.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/client.cjs.js",
    "types": "./dist/client.d.ts"
  }
},
"types": "dist/index.d.ts"
```
Keep top-level `type` unchanged and use explicit .mjs/.cjs to avoid flipping module semantics.

devon: Also recommend adding `"./package.json": "./package.json"` to exports so bundlers can read metadata when resolving subpaths.

mina: Can we add a tiny CI smoke test that does `npm pack` -> install tarball into examples/next-starter and runs: node require check, node dynamic import check, vite/next build, and `tsc --noEmit`? That would catch both runtime and typing regressions.

ci-bot: CI: examples/pack-smoke -> exports-resolution-matrix failed on step "next-build" (exit 1).

olga: One more gotcha: pnpm workspace linking hides this during internal dev. Our CI that used workspace:link passed; publishing and pack-based install fails. We should run pack-based integration in CI for examples before cutting releases.

chris: I'll open a patch: restore conditional exports + types for subpaths, add `./package.json` export, and add the pack-smoke matrix job. Also add a short onboarding note in examples/README: two consumption patterns (CJS require and ESM import) and how to debug ERR_REQUIRE_ESM.

mina: Thanks. Please add a CHANGELOG line and ping #all-hands if we need an urgent docs snippet for onboarding.

devon: Long-term: add a pre-publish lint that validates each exported subpath has import or require keys for ESM/CJS parity and alerts when types are missing. Would have prevented this.

chris: Yup. PR incoming, tagging @olga for review.
